text:
incident-bot: Pager: high-rate auth-validation errors detected -> /v1/auth/validate returning 500s. Spike began at 22:06:29 UTC. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/alerts/3902. Related S3 access anomalies to staging-logs bucket matching same timeframe. Severity: potential credential compromise. Paging oncall.

ivan_oncall: ack, I'm on it. Pulling up traces and auth service logs. any immediate customer reports?

sara_ops: seeing a concentrated source of traffic from two IPs: 54.38.12.23 and 18.205.66.44. Lots of rapid auth validation calls with X-Service-Token header. Also matches S3 GETs to staging-logs/ingest/2026-03-15/*.gz by agent svc-ingest-runner. snippet from auth logs:```[2026-03-15T22:06:31Z] WARN auth.validate - svc-ingest token failed KV lookup, error: malformed-kv
[2026-03-15T22:06:31Z] INFO proxy - client=54.38.12.23 path=/v1/auth/validate headers={Authorization:Bearer xxxxx, X-Service-Token: svc-ingest/ak-ABCD1234}```

kevin_sec: if there's evidence of service token reuse + unauthorized S3 access, treat as credential compromise. Recommend immediate rotate of svc-ingest keys, revoke all active sessions for svc-ingest, and block those source IPs at the edge. I'll start a forensic copy of affected logs (do not delete objects).

lila_support: two customers reported ingestion failures around 22:07 UTC: ticket #4521 and #4523. No reports of data exfil yet, they saw 500s and retry errors. Drafting short status update for customers.

ivan_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) add WAF rule to block 54.38.12.23 and 18.205.66.44 CIDRs 2) throttle /v1/auth/validate to 10rps per src 3) rotate svc-ingest service keys 4) revoke sessions and rotate any KMS-encrypted config referencing old key. I'll do 1-2 now.

sara_ops: applying WAF rule now. command:```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' https://edge-api.internal/waf/rules -d '{"action":"block","cidr":"54.38.12.23/32","reason":"auth flood"}'```blocked traffic for those ips, seeing auth error rate drop ~65% in 2m.

kevin_sec: starting key rotation. Steps I'll coordinate with ops: ```# create new access key
aws iam create-access-key --user-name svc-ingest
# update secrets manager
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id svc/ingest/key --secret-string '{"access_key":"AKIA...","secret":"..."}'
# then revoke old keys
aws iam delete-access-key --user-name svc-ingest --access-key-id OLDKEY123
```Marking this as immediate. Also running quick Athena query to list S3 GETs:```SELECT requesturi, requester, timestamp FROM s3_access_logs WHERE bucket='staging-logs' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-15T22:00:00' AND '2026-03-15T22:15:00' AND requesturi LIKE '%ingest%';```

lila_support: customer message draft (short): "We detected a disruption to ingestion services around 22:06 UTC; our team is rotating service credentials and implementing mitigation. No customer data loss is confirmed; we'll follow up within 2 hours with findings." please review @kevin_sec @ivan_oncall

kevin_sec: looks good. Add line: "We have rotated keys and blocked suspect IPs; a forensic review is ongoing."

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity -> Sev2. Oncall paged 22:06:30. Runbook link: https://wiki.internal/incidents/2034506789

ivan_oncall: I'm going to hand off to night oncall @alex_night in 30m. leaving checklist: - confirm WAF blocks hold - ensure new keys propagated to staging/primary - revoke any long-lived tokens created before 22:00 UTC - preserve forensic copies of S3 objects - update status page at each milestone

sara_ops: key rotation in progress, new key created and injected into staging secrets. Waiting on primary rollout after smoke tests. smoke test result: auth validate success -> 200 for svc-ingest with new key.

kevin_sec: forensic notes: found ~12 GETs to staging-logs/* where referrer header includes 'runner/ci' and two distinct User-Agent values: "svc-ingest-runner/1.3" and "curl/7.68.0". running grep for patterns that look like Authorization headers inside logs (possible accidental token leakage):```aws s3 cp s3://staging-logs/ingest/2026-03-15/part-0001.gz - | zgrep -E "Authorization:|X-Service-Token"```If PII or cleartext tokens found, escalate to compliance.

lila_support: updated status page and posted customer note to affected tickets. Customers acknowledged and appreciate the quick notice.

ivan_oncall: handing off now to @alex_night. I'm available via DM. next steps for night oncall: monitor auth error rate, confirm old keys deleted, keep WAF rule for 24h, complete full S3 object audit in morning.

alex_night: taking it. thanks for the handoff. will post an update by 02:00 UTC and escalate to infra if we see resurgence.

kevin_sec: ACTIONS (open): [rotate-svc-ingest-keys], [revoke-old-tokens-before-22:00], [preserve-s3-objects], [athena-s3-audit], [customer-communication]. assigned: kevin_sec/sara_ops/ivan_oncall/lila_support. ETA initial report 2h. :white_check_mark:
